title: Multi-agent compatibility
context: Project work may move among different AI providers, IDEs, or coding agents.
problem: Avoid relying on a provider-only feature or automatic discovery behavior.
options_considered: Provider-independent repository protocol with optional instruction-file links.
Require one agent's proprietary memory or instruction mechanism.
decision: Define a common repository onboarding/execution/handoff protocol; provider-specific integrations are optional convenience links.
rationale: Markdown and repository evidence are inspectable by humans and diverse agents.
consequences: New agents must follow explicit onboarding rather than assume conversation history.
No claim of tested compatibility with every provider is made.
